1443. Sorting Algorithm Time Complexity Analysis

70

Hard

Problem Statement:
Write a Java program that demonstrates the analysis of sorting algorithms. Implement two sorting algorithms of your choice (e.g., Bubble Sort, Merge Sort) and compare their time complexities for sorting arrays of various sizes.
input_spec:
The size of the array (integer).
The elements of the array (integers separated by spaces).
output_spec:
Display the sorted array for each algorithm.
Display the execution time (in milliseconds) for each algorithm.
